era: 2019 desktop amazon.com as every signed-out and signed-in US visitor saw it: navy #232f3e two-row header (logo with Try Prime, All-scope search with orange button, promo slot top right, Deliver to / nav links / EN, Account & Lists, Orders, Try Prime, Cart), grey home page with white square cards, search results with a bordered left refinement column and 'Sort by: Featured', product pages with a gradient buy box. All 2019 sources agree (s1-s16); there is no crawler-only variant for Amazon.
